## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      4 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 5 sept 2026 - 10 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _khaldonalsalami_, 10 sept 2026, 1/5: "i just hope u have cancelled my account and stopped my subscription"
            2. _Gajanan Patil_, 6 sept 2026, 1/5: "😞 it wastes your time as guest also you have to pay or subscribe. paid app"
            3. _Kay Wilkins_, 5 sept 2026, 2/5: "I canceled my subscription and deleted the app. I was charged again today. No warning. I want my money refunded."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      6 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 23 may 2026 - 11 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Jerick Órdenes_, 11 sept 2026, 1/5: "The app freezes on every start and sometimes crashes. It's very annoying for a paid app."
            2. _Sabina Kotiranta_, 23 may 2026, 1/5: "would be nice if it stops crashing.... Reinstalled it twice now."
            3. _Bartholomew Lunt_, 23 jul 2026, 2/5: "daily work out is good but it keeps crashing and I can't track anything except the daily workout once it actually loads."
<!--/ir-theme-->
